subtasks: Pick up the mallet and strike all xylophone keys from left to right.
Continue the left-to-right sequence with the mallet in the left hand. Strike the four remaining keys in order: light blue, dark blue, purple, then magenta. Lift the head over 2.5 cm between hits.
With the mallet clear of the xylophone after the final strike, return the arms to their starting positions.
Continue from the leftmost red key, lifting the mallet head well clear between hits. Strike orange, yellow, green, light blue, dark blue, purple and magenta in that order.
